verdict.summary: The change correctly bounds both observability drop-diagnostic seams without changing row validation, normalized output, or build/refusal behavior. Counters are scoped independently per seam, suppressed and total counts are computed consistently, and collector-controlled queue-class text remains sanitized before logging. The added self-tests are non-vacuous and use literal boundary/overflow sizes and expected messages; they cover below/at/above-cap behavior, real totals, per-build evidence accounting, seam independence, accepted data, and silent no-drop paths. No trust check, workflow permission, or untrusted-input handling is weakened.
